description: Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 30B A3B Q6_K_L by bartowski
gpu_tip: ~36GB total. Same hybrid-architecture math as the Q8_0 build above — Nemotron 3.5's few attention layers keep context nearly free memory-wise. An 8GB GPU (e.g. RTX 3060 Ti) plus ~32GB of DDR5 system RAM handles it comfortably.
mac_tip: Needs ~36GB — fits a 48GB MacBook Pro comfortably; tight on 36GB.
